def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    # Non-background colors on a border are short bars; project their midpoint inward.
    marker=[(r,c,v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and (r not in (0,h-1) and c not in (0,w-1))]
    if not marker: return out
    mr,mc,mv=marker[0]
    out[mr][mc]=4
    for side in ('top','bottom','left','right'):
        cells=[]
        if side=='top': cells=[(0,c) for c in range(w) if grid[0][c]!=bg]
        if side=='bottom': cells=[(h-1,c) for c in range(w) if grid[h-1][c]!=bg]
        if side=='left': cells=[(r,0) for r in range(h) if grid[r][0]!=bg]
        if side=='right': cells=[(r,w-1) for r in range(h) if grid[r][w-1]!=bg]
        if not cells: continue
        if side in ('top','bottom'):
            c=round(sum(p[1] for p in cells)/len(cells)); r=0 if side=='top' else h-1; dr=1 if side=='top' else -1
            for rr in range(r+dr, h-1 if side=='top' else 0, dr):
                if out[rr][c]==bg: out[rr][c]=mv
        else:
            r=round(sum(p[0] for p in cells)/len(cells)); c=0 if side=='left' else w-1; dc=1 if side=='left' else -1
            for cc in range(c+dc, w-1 if side=='left' else 0, dc):
                if out[r][cc]==bg: out[r][cc]=mv
    return out
PY
